prompts.name: warden
prompts.spec: SUBJECT: stocky undead shield warden, iron closed helmet with narrow dark eye slit, dull cool gray steel armor with restrained verdigris recesses, deep burgundy short torn tabard, broad rectangular worn iron shield in its left hand and a short heavy mace in its right. No spikes, tiny rivets or shifting decorative scratches. Broad distinct silhouette. Muted gray, dark plum and burgundy; bone-beige small accents. WALK a weighty march with shield held steady. ATTACK one deliberate short mace blow after drawing the mace back; shield stays in the same hand, body twist modest, planted feet. Left and right views are separately painted, not mirrored.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art enemy animation sprite atlas for a top-down 2D dark-fantasy dungeon game Coinbound.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES only: the user's burgundy swordsman and green archer contact sheets. Match their sober small-scale proportions, muted colors, dark plum outlines, 3/4 top-down view, visible head/shoulders and feet. Improve temporal consistency; do not copy reference checkerboard.
OUTPUT: transparent PNG, square 2048 x 2048. EXACTLY 8 columns by 8 rows of equal 256x256 cells, no gutters, labels, text, grid, background, ground shadows or decorative effects. Exactly 64 separated sprites, one in every cell. Work as deliberate low-resolution pixel art enlarged 4x nearest-neighbor: final intended logical cell 64x64, character roughly 24-36 pixels wide and 45-48 pixels tall. Crisp square clusters, no antialias, no gradient, no texture noise, no dithering. Maximum 24 opaque colors for the entire character.
CRITICAL ANIMATION INVARIANTS: One identical character model across all 64 frames: same anatomy, costume, silhouette volume, size, equipment, color palette, and lighting. FIXED illumination from upper-left of screen in every facing; never mirror lighting. Keep cluster patterns stable on rigid materials; no redrawing random surface detail. Root anchor in every cell at local x128 y224 (logical x32 y56). The sprite stays in place, no drift around atlas cells. Top of upright head around local y32. Feet grounded at y224 except intentionally lifted swing foot. No change of camera, lens, scale or perspective. Keep all pixels inside each cell with at least 12px margin. Full silhouettes and full weapons.
ROW ORDER, from top to bottom:
row1 WALK facing DOWN toward viewer; row2 ATTACK facing DOWN;
row3 WALK facing LEFT; row4 ATTACK facing LEFT;
row5 WALK facing RIGHT; row6 ATTACK facing RIGHT;
row7 WALK facing UP away from viewer; row8 ATTACK facing UP.
Each walk row: 8 ordered phases of one subtle seamless in-place locomotion cycle: contact, down, passing, up, opposite contact, down, passing, up; adjacent frames small changes; frame7 transitions naturally to frame0. Stable torso, 0-1 logical-pixel bob, genuine alternating limbs, not eight independently invented poses.
Each attack row: 8 ordered phases ONCE: 0 neutral, 1 early anticipation, 2 deep readable anticipation, 3 held anticipation, 4 active impact/release, 5 follow-through, 6 recovery, 7 original neutral. LOCK same facing across row. No in-air arrows, separate particles, flashes, or drawn attack arcs; weapon motion itself conveys attack. Animation should read clearly even at 64x64. Identity and clean stable shading matter more than detail.
SUBJECT: stocky undead shield warden, iron closed helmet with narrow dark eye slit, dull cool gray steel armor with restrained verdigris recesses, deep burgundy short torn tabard, broad rectangular worn iron shield in its left hand and a short heavy mace in its right. No spikes, tiny rivets or shifting decorative scratches. Broad distinct silhouette. Muted gray, dark plum and burgundy; bone-beige small accents. WALK a weighty march with shield held steady. ATTACK one deliberate short mace blow after drawing the mace back; shield stays in the same hand, body twist modest, planted feet. Left and right views are separately painted, not mirrored.

prompts.name: arbalist
prompts.spec: SUBJECT: thin undead crossbow skirmisher, muted ochre hood and short cloak, narrow pale bone face under deep shadow, dark brown leather armor, simple small wooden crossbow held with both hands at chest height, small brown bolt case on hip. No loose arrows or arrows behind head; no sword, no shield. Dark sepia, ochre, plum outlines and bone color. Clear small readable silhouette distinct from the player's green archer. WALK cautious alternating short steps with crossbow steady and tiny cloak follow-through. ATTACK 0 resting low crossbow, 1 lift, 2 aim, 3 hold aim, 4 release and tiny shoulder recoil, 5 hand pulls reload mechanism, 6 lower, 7 neutral. Crossbow geometry must stay constant. No flying bolt in atlas.

prompts.name: cultist
prompts.spec: SUBJECT: slender sinister swamp oracle in muted deep teal and desaturated purple layered robe, ivory wooden mask with two dark eye slots, single crooked wooden staff in its right hand topped by a small dull jade stone. No antlers, no floating particles or changing ornaments. Boots visible below robe. Color accents restrained, no neon. WALK slow grounded small steps with gentle coherent robe sway, staff in same hand. ATTACK 0 neutral staff planted, 1 staff raised slightly and free hand opens, 2 raised staff and outstretched free hand, 3 holds casting pose, 4 decisive small downward staff gesture, 5 settles, 6 lowers hand, 7 original neutral. Jade stone unchanged shape/size in every frame; any magic VFX will be separate engine effect.

prompts.name: ghoul
prompts.spec: SUBJECT: compact feral hunched humanoid dungeon ghoul with long forearms and two digitigrade legs, charcoal gray skin, sparse rust-red mane along upper back, pale bone claws, ember-orange tiny eyes. No clothes or weapons, no wings, no tail. Silhouette lower and wider than player, logical standing height about 36 pixels, fixed ground anchor still y56, so head lower than tall enemies. Crisp muscular forms built from big pixel clusters, no hair noise. WALK low prowling cycle with alternating left/right feet and a little arm movement; consistent spine, head and mane. ATTACK a planted crouch-to-lunge sequence, frame0 neutral, 1 slight crouch, 2 deep crouch, 3 hold crouch, 4 forward reach with claws without root translation, 5 compact landing crouch, 6 straightens, 7 original neutral. Actual world leap displacement will be handled by game; do not translate character across the cell. No stretchy changing anatomy.
